text: Binary flag from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it; order irrelevant): 1 if at least one comment itself offers specific empirical evidence supporting its counter-argument, i.e. concrete data, statistics, study/research findings, documented real-world cases or specific factual observations (a specific personal experience can count). 0 if comments are assessable but none have such evidence (purely abstract/logical reasoning, opinion, generic unsupported factual assertions, or vague appeals without specifics). Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither evidence nor excluded. Empty list -> 0; missing or malformed input -> null.
